类 EntityDeathEvent

public class EntityDeathEvent extends EntityEvent implements Cancellable
当一个实体死亡时触发本事件

原文： Thrown whenever a LivingEntity dies

    • getDroppedExp

      public int getDroppedExp()
      返回这个死亡的实体掉落的经验数量.

      这不表明这个实体有多少经验值,而是它死亡时应该被创建多少掉落的经验值.

      原文： Gets how much EXP should be dropped from this death.

      This does not indicate how much EXP should be taken from the entity in question, merely how much should be created after its death.

      返回:
      返回掉落的经验值数量

      原文：Amount of EXP to drop.

    • setDroppedExp

      这不表明这个实体有多少经验值,而是它死亡时应该被创建多少掉落的经验值.

      原文： Sets how much EXP should be dropped from this death.

      This does not indicate how much EXP should be taken from the entity in question, merely how much should be created after its death.

      参数:
      exp - 掉落的经验值的数量

      原文：Amount of EXP to drop.

    • setReviveHealth

      public void setReviveHealth(double reviveHealth) throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
      Set the amount of health that the entity should revive with after cancelling the event. Revive health value must be between 0 (exclusive) and the entity's max health (inclusive).
      参数:
      reviveHealth - The amount of health
      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if the health is <= 0 or > max health
